name: Gaussian 1/f^β noise transmittance model
definition: A closed-form transmittance model assuming the line-averaged density follows a Gaussian distribution derived from 1/f^β fractal noise.
summary: The Gaussian 1/f^beta noise transmittance model computes ensemble-averaged transmittance using a symmetric normal distribution, offering a simple analytic solution that differs from the Gamma model by allowing nonphysical negative extinction values.
